definitions.explanation: A computer-generated simulation of a three-dimensional environment that can be interacted with using special equipment such as headsets and controllers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{仮想|かそう}→仮想：17756_kasou⟧ (virtual, imaginary) + ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧ (reality). The Japanese translation of "virtual reality." In casual speech, the abbreviation VR (ブイアール) is more commonly used, but {仮想現実|かそうげんじつ} appears in formal writing and news.

- {仮想現実|かそうげんじつ}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: VR technology
- {仮想現実|かそうげんじつ}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: VR game
- {仮想現実|かそうげんじつ}⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧: virtual reality space
- {仮想現実|かそうげんじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}する→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧: to experience VR
